annotations.title: Send a request to a licensed real estate agency

description: Send the person's request to a licensed real estate agency (AMI) in Portugal, after their explicit consent. It is about buying or selling a home or a new-build development. Two steps: call with mode=prepare and their details (name, phone with preferred channel or else email, city or project, language); show them the returned summary and the GDPR (RGPD) consent text word for word, and only if they explicitly agree call with mode=submit, the same details, confirmation_token, consent=true and consent_text_version. Never set consent=true on your own. mode=link (default) only returns the form link.

budget.description: Optional. Budget in whole euros, e.g. 350000

channel.description: How the person wants to be contacted on that phone

city.description: Municipality in Portugal, Portuguese name (Porto, Matosinhos, Lisboa). Not needed with project

client.description: Optional. Your app's host or name, e.g. claude.ai or chatgpt.com: recorded as the request's source

confirmation_token.description: submit only: the token returned by prepare

consent.description: submit only: true once the person has read the consent text returned by prepare and explicitly agreed

consent_text_version.description: submit only: consent_text_version returned by prepare

email.description: Only if the person gives no phone

intent.description: Optional. visit and reserve only with a project on sale, notify only with a project not yet on sale

language.description: The person's language: pt, en, ru, ua, de, fr, nl (uk is accepted too). The consent text and the emails come in it. Default: en

message.description: Optional. The person's own words, up to 2000 characters

mode.description: link (default): only the form link and the consent text. prepare: check the details, get a summary, the consent text and a confirmation_token; nothing is sent. submit: send the request — the same details as in prepare plus confirmation_token, consent=true and consent_text_version, only after the person has read the consent text and explicitly agreed

phone.description: Phone in international format (+351 912 345 678). Preferred over email

preferred_time.description: Optional, with intent=visit: when suits the person

project.description: Optional. Slug of a development from the flatin.pt catalogue the request is about

typology.description: Optional. Bedroom counts wanted (T2 = two bedrooms)
